node_kinds.name: Vault_Server
node_kinds.description: A HashiCorp Vault server or cluster instance.

node_kinds.name: Vault_Namespace
node_kinds.description: A Vault namespace that acts as a tenancy and containment boundary for Vault resources.

node_kinds.name: Vault_Store
node_kinds.description: A namespace-local registry used to organize and manage a family of Vault objects.

node_kinds.name: Vault_Policy
node_kinds.description: An ACL, RGP, or EGP policy document that defines path-based capabilities in Vault.

node_kinds.name: Vault_ManagedKey
node_kinds.description: A named Enterprise managed key that delegates cryptographic operations to an external KMS or HSM backend.

node_kinds.name: Vault_Entity
node_kinds.description: A canonical Vault identity that accumulates policies from direct assignment, group membership, and aliases.

node_kinds.name: Vault_EntityAlias
node_kinds.description: An authentication pathway that binds an external credential or login name to a Vault entity on a specific auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_Group
node_kinds.description: A Vault internal or external group that aggregates entities and grants policies through membership.

node_kinds.name: Vault_GroupAlias
node_kinds.description: An external group mapping bound to an auth method mount that resolves into a Vault group.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcApplication
node_kinds.description: An OIDC application configured to trust a Vault OIDC provider.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcKey
node_kinds.description: An OIDC signing key resource used by Vault OIDC applications.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcAssignment
node_kinds.description: An OIDC assignment that links Vault entities or groups to OIDC application access.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcProvider
node_kinds.description: An outbound OIDC provider configuration where Vault acts as an identity provider.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcScope
node_kinds.description: An outbound OIDC scope definition exposed by Vault identity.

node_kinds.name: Vault_OidcTokenRole
node_kinds.description: A Vault identity-token role that defines the signing key, claims template, and TTL used to mint OIDC-compliant identity tokens.

node_kinds.name: Vault_MfaMethod
node_kinds.description: A configured Vault login MFA method such as TOTP, Okta, Duo, or PingID.

node_kinds.name: Vault_MfaLoginEnforcement
node_kinds.description: A Vault login MFA enforcement rule that selects entities, groups, or auth methods and requires one of its configured MFA methods.

node_kinds.name: Vault_ScimClient
node_kinds.description: A Vault Enterprise SCIM client registration that authorizes a principal to provision identity data through SCIM.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethod
node_kinds.description: A mounted authentication method that maps external identities into Vault entities.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthRole
node_kinds.description: A named role within an auth method that binds external identity attributes to Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthUser
node_kinds.description: A user principal managed by or referenced from a Vault authentication method.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthGroup
node_kinds.description: A group principal managed by or referenced from a Vault authentication method.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodAliCloud
node_kinds.description: An AliCloud authentication method mount that validates AliCloud identity material and authorizes logins through named AliCloud auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthAliCloudRole
node_kinds.description: A named AliCloud auth role that constrains AliCloud login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodApprole
node_kinds.description: An AppRole authentication method mount that issues tokens to machines or applications using RoleID and SecretID credentials.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthApproleRole
node_kinds.description: A named AppRole role that defines token policies and login constraints for machine authentication.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodAws
node_kinds.description: An AWS authentication method mount that validates AWS identity material and authorizes logins through named AWS auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthAwsRole
node_kinds.description: A named AWS auth role that constrains AWS login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodAzure
node_kinds.description: An Azure authentication method mount that validates Azure-issued JWTs and authorizes logins through named Azure auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthAzureRole
node_kinds.description: A named Azure auth role that constrains Azure JWT login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodCf
node_kinds.description: A Cloud Foundry authentication method mount that validates Cloud Foundry identity material and authorizes logins through named Cloud Foundry auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthCfRole
node_kinds.description: A named Cloud Foundry auth role that constrains Cloud Foundry login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodGithub
node_kinds.description: A GitHub authentication method mount that maps GitHub teams and users to Vault policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthGithubUser
node_kinds.description: A mapped GitHub user entry within a GitHub auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthGithubTeam
node_kinds.description: A mapped GitHub team entry within a GitHub auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodGcp
node_kinds.description: A Google Cloud authentication method mount that validates GCP-issued identity material and authorizes logins through named GCP auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthGcpRole
node_kinds.description: A named GCP auth role that constrains Google Cloud login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodJwtOidc
node_kinds.description: A shared JWT/OIDC authentication method mount that validates direct JWT logins and browser-based OIDC logins through named roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthJwtOidcRole
node_kinds.description: A named JWT/OIDC auth role that constrains token or browser-based login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodKerberos
node_kinds.description: A Kerberos authentication method mount that authenticates principals against a Kerberos realm and maps LDAP-backed groups to Vault policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthKerberosGroup
node_kinds.description: A mapped Kerberos group entry within a Kerberos auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodKubernetes
node_kinds.description: A Kubernetes authentication method mount that validates service account JWTs and authorizes them through named Kubernetes auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthKubernetesRole
node_kinds.description: A named Kubernetes auth role that constrains service account JWT login and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodLdap
node_kinds.description: An LDAP authentication method mount that authenticates users against an LDAP directory and maps users or groups to Vault policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthLdapUser
node_kinds.description: A mapped LDAP username entry within an LDAP auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthLdapGroup
node_kinds.description: A mapped LDAP group entry within an LDAP auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodOci
node_kinds.description: An OCI authentication method mount that validates OCI signed identity requests and authorizes logins through named OCI auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthOciRole
node_kinds.description: A named OCI auth role that maps OCI group or dynamic-group OCIDs to Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodOkta
node_kinds.description: An Okta authentication method mount that maps configured Okta users and groups to Vault policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthOktaUser
node_kinds.description: A mapped Okta user entry within an Okta auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthOktaGroup
node_kinds.description: A mapped Okta group entry within an Okta auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodRadius
node_kinds.description: A RADIUS authentication method mount that delegates login validation to an upstream RADIUS server.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthRadiusUser
node_kinds.description: A mapped RADIUS username entry within a RADIUS auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodSaml
node_kinds.description: A SAML authentication method mount that validates SAML assertions and authorizes logins through named SAML auth roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthSamlRole
node_kinds.description: A named SAML auth role that constrains assertion subject and attribute matching and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodScep
node_kinds.description: A SCEP authentication method mount that provides delegated static-challenge or Intune authentication for PKI SCEP enrollment workflows.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthScepRole
node_kinds.description: A named SCEP auth role that controls delegated PKI SCEP authentication behavior and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodSpiffe
node_kinds.description: A SPIFFE authentication method mount that validates JWT or X.509 SPIFFE SVIDs against a configured trust domain and trust bundle.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthSpiffeRole
node_kinds.description: A named SPIFFE auth role that maps workload ID patterns to Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodTlsCert
node_kinds.description: A TLS certificate authentication method mount that authenticates clients against configured trusted certificate roles and CRLs.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTlsCertRole
node_kinds.description: A named trusted certificate role that authenticates TLS clients and grants Vault token policies.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTlsCertCrl
node_kinds.description: A configured certificate revocation list resource within the TLS certificate auth method.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodToken
node_kinds.description: The built-in token authentication method mount that issues, revokes, and constrains Vault tokens.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenRole
node_kinds.description: A named token role that constrains token issuance behavior on the token auth method.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthMethodUserpass
node_kinds.description: A UserPass authentication method mount that manages local username and password identities.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AuthUserpassUser
node_kinds.description: A managed username entry within a UserPass auth method mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngine
node_kinds.description: A mounted secrets engine that stores or generates secrets and credentials.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsRole
node_kinds.description: A named role within a secrets engine that defines a credential generation template or access pattern.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineAws
node_kinds.description: An AWS secrets engine mount that manages dynamic IAM or STS credentials and static IAM-user access keys.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AwsRole
node_kinds.description: A named AWS secrets engine role that defines how Vault generates dynamic IAM-user or STS credentials.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AwsStaticRole
node_kinds.description: A named AWS static role that manages long-lived access keys for a mapped IAM user.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineAzure
node_kinds.description: An Azure secrets engine mount that manages dynamic Azure service-principal credentials and Enterprise static Azure application credentials.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AzureRole
node_kinds.description: A named Azure secrets engine role that defines how Vault generates Azure service-principal credentials.

node_kinds.name: Vault_AzureStaticRole
node_kinds.description: A named Enterprise Azure static role that manages long-lived client secrets for an existing Azure application.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineDatabase
node_kinds.description: A database secrets engine mount that manages database connections plus dynamic and static database credential roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_DatabaseConnection
node_kinds.description: A named database connection configuration used by database secrets engine roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_DatabaseRole
node_kinds.description: A named dynamic database role that generates lease-backed database credentials through an associated connection.

node_kinds.name: Vault_DatabaseStaticRole
node_kinds.description: A named static database role that manages the current credentials of an existing database account.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineGcp
node_kinds.description: A Google Cloud secrets engine mount that manages Vault-owned rolesets, externally managed static accounts, and impersonated-account token generation.

node_kinds.name: Vault_GcpRoleset
node_kinds.description: A Vault-managed GCP roleset that owns a service account and generates OAuth2 access tokens or service account keys.

node_kinds.name: Vault_GcpStaticAccount
node_kinds.description: A GCP static account configuration that lets Vault generate credentials for an externally managed service account.

node_kinds.name: Vault_GcpImpersonatedAccount
node_kinds.description: A GCP impersonated-account configuration that generates short-lived OAuth2 access tokens for an existing service account.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineGcpKms
node_kinds.description: A Google Cloud KMS secrets engine mount that performs cryptographic operations against Cloud KMS-backed keys.

node_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsKey
node_kinds.description: A named Vault GCP KMS key backed by a Google Cloud KMS crypto key and used for cryptographic operations or lifecycle management.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineKv
node_kinds.description: A KV secrets engine mount that stores versioned or unversioned secret data.

node_kinds.name: Vault_KvDirectory
node_kinds.description: A logical KV directory path discovered beneath a KV secrets engine mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_KvFile
node_kinds.description: A logical KV secret path that may expose data, metadata, and lifecycle endpoints.

node_kinds.name: Vault_KvPair
node_kinds.description: A top-level key entry within a KV file. The key name is stored for visibility, but not the plaintext value.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineKubernetes
node_kinds.description: A Kubernetes secrets engine mount that generates Kubernetes service account tokens and related RBAC objects.

node_kinds.name: Vault_KubernetesRole
node_kinds.description: A named Kubernetes secrets engine role that defines how Kubernetes service account credentials are generated.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineLdap
node_kinds.description: An LDAP secrets engine mount that manages static and dynamic LDAP credentials as well as service-account libraries.

node_kinds.name: Vault_LdapDynamicRole
node_kinds.description: A named LDAP dynamic role that generates ephemeral LDAP credentials from a creation template.

node_kinds.name: Vault_LdapStaticRole
node_kinds.description: A named LDAP static role that binds Vault to a managed LDAP account and exposes credential rotation and retrieval surfaces.

node_kinds.name: Vault_LdapLibrarySet
node_kinds.description: A named LDAP library set that manages a pool of service accounts which can be checked out and checked in.

node_kinds.name: Vault_LdapServiceAccount
node_kinds.description: A service account member of an LDAP library set.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEnginePki
node_kinds.description: A PKI secrets engine mount that issues or signs X.509 material.

node_kinds.name: Vault_PkiRole
node_kinds.description: A named PKI role that constrains certificate issuance and signing behavior.

node_kinds.name: Vault_PkiIssuer
node_kinds.description: A CA issuer object within a PKI mount.

node_kinds.name: Vault_PkiKey
node_kinds.description: A private or managed key object referenced by a PKI issuer.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineSsh
node_kinds.description: An SSH secrets engine mount that generates SSH OTPs or signs SSH certificates.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SshRole
node_kinds.description: A named SSH role that defines either OTP generation or SSH certificate issuance behavior.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineTerraform
node_kinds.description: A Terraform secrets engine mount that generates HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise API tokens from named roles.

node_kinds.name: Vault_TerraformRole
node_kinds.description: A named Terraform secrets engine role that maps Vault access to HCP Terraform organization, team, legacy team, or user API tokens.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineTotp
node_kinds.description: A TOTP secrets engine mount that stores TOTP key definitions and generates or validates time-based one-time passwords.

node_kinds.name: Vault_TotpKey
node_kinds.description: A named TOTP key definition used to generate or validate time-based one-time passwords.

node_kinds.name: Vault_SecretsEngineTransit
node_kinds.description: A Transit secrets engine mount that performs cryptographic operations using managed key material.

node_kinds.name: Vault_TransitKey
node_kinds.description: A Transit key object used for cryptographic operations and key lifecycle management.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: Containment edge showing that a Vault server contains a namespace, a namespace contains a top-level Vault object, or a parent object contains its immediate observed child object.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_References
relationship_kinds.description: Non-hierarchical configuration reference from one resolved Vault object to another; Reference Types and Reference Evidence describe the relationship.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ParentOf
relationship_kinds.description: Namespace authority edge showing that a parent namespace can assert control over a child namespace.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MemberOf
relationship_kinds.description: Membership edge indicating that an entity or child group inherits permissions from a Vault group.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MapsTo
relationship_kinds.description: Identity resolution edge showing that the source identity representation maps to the target identity representation.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_LinksPolicy
relationship_kinds.description: Policy relationship showing that the source is directly assigned, configured to grant, or otherwise linked to the target Vault policy. Policy Link Types distinguishes direct assignments, authentication grants, auth-method defaults, and unregistered-user defaults.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_DenyAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Access capability edge showing that a Vault policy explicitly denies access on the target path or resource.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_PotentialAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable evidence edge showing that an otherwise attack-path-producing operation has an unobserved synthetic target, a target selected only at runtime, or an unresolved compatibility prerequisite; Potential Outcomes identifies what access could become possible after resolution.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OnAuthMethod
relationship_kinds.description: Structural edge showing that an entity alias or group alias exists on an auth method mount.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ManagedBy
relationship_kinds.description: Evidence-backed reference edge showing that the source Vault object delegates cryptographic operations to the target managed key. Reference Evidence identifies the Vault response that exposed the exact link; compatibility remains a separate authorization question.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_CanUseManagedKey
relationship_kinds.description: Reference edge showing that a PKI, SSH, or Transit mount is authorized to consume the target managed key through its mount allowlist or the managed key's any-mount setting. Authorization Sources, Compatible Usages, and Compatibility Known distinguish permission from usable cryptographic operations.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ReadIdentity
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable identity visibility edge showing that a Vault policy or derived effective identity permission can read, look up, or introspect identity records and token claims; edge properties identify the query operation and information returned.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ReadCredential
relationship_kinds.description: Credential-exposure edge showing that a Vault policy can read confirmed reusable credential material from a concrete identity object, such as a confidential OIDC application client secret or a Duo or Okta MFA integration credential.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GenerateIdentityToken
relationship_kinds.description: Identity-token access edge showing that a Vault policy can mint an OIDC-compliant identity token from the target role or a namespace-scoped role surface when the signing key permits that role client ID.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcAllowsApplication
relationship_kinds.description: Configuration edge showing that a Vault OIDC provider authorizes the target OIDC application.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcGrantsAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Configuration edge showing that a Vault OIDC assignment is referenced by an OIDC application; application use still requires provider authorization.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcSupportsScope
relationship_kinds.description: Configuration edge showing that a Vault OIDC provider advertises support for the target OIDC scope.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcAssignedTo
relationship_kinds.description: Assignment edge showing that an entity or group is included in a Vault OIDC assignment.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcAuthorize
relationship_kinds.description: OIDC access edge showing that a Vault policy can invoke the authorize endpoint for the target provider or provider pattern.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_OidcAuthenticateTo
relationship_kinds.description: Derived OIDC access edge showing that an entity both satisfies an application's assignment requirements and has effective identity-policy or resolvable token-policy access to an allowed provider authorize endpoint.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MfaUsesMethod
relationship_kinds.description: Constraint edge showing that a Vault MFA login enforcement accepts the target MFA method as one way to satisfy the rule.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MfaAppliesTo
relationship_kinds.description: Constraint edge showing that a Vault MFA login enforcement applies to the target entity, group, or auth method selector.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MfaSelfEnroll
relationship_kinds.description: Identity MFA edge showing that a Vault policy can invoke TOTP self-enrollment on an eligible MFA method.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_MfaGenerateSecret
relationship_kinds.description: Identity MFA edge showing that a Vault policy can generate a TOTP secret for the calling token's entity through a TOTP MFA method.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ScimUsesPrincipal
relationship_kinds.description: SCIM configuration edge showing that the source SCIM client uses the target entity as its access-grant principal.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ScimProtocolAccess
relationship_kinds.description: SCIM protocol access edge showing that a Vault policy grants authenticated access to SCIM user, group, or discovery surfaces; effective use still requires a matching SCIM access-grant principal.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ScimManages
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable SCIM ownership edge showing that the source SCIM client provisioned and owns the target Vault entity or internal group; effective mutation rights are emitted directly from the access-grant entity to matched resources.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ScimReadResources
relationship_kinds.description: Derived SCIM visibility edge showing that the target client's access-grant entity has effective permission to read, query, list, or discover SCIM resources.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ScimProvisionResources
relationship_kinds.description: Derived SCIM provisioning edge from a client's access-grant entity directly to an observed client-owned Vault entity or internal group matched by effective replace, patch, or delete permission; collection creation and unresolved targets use Vault_PotentialAccess.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ListObjects
relationship_kinds.description: Visibility edge showing that a Vault policy can enumerate durable objects in the target store, auth method, secrets engine collection, or KV directory; Object Types and Operations identify the normalized resource family and returned resources.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_CreateObject
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy can create the exact synthetic target object or potentially create objects beneath the target mount or namespace-scoped store; Object Types and Scope identify the normalized resource family and affected collection.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ReadObject
relationship_kinds.description: Visibility edge showing that a Vault policy can read a concrete durable object; the target node kind and normalized Object Types identify the resource and available read surface.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ManageObject
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy can update, delete, rotate, import, or otherwise manage a concrete durable object; the target node kind, normalized Object Types, Operations, and Requirements identify the available actions.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ControlObject
relationship_kinds.description: Derived attack-path edge showing that the source authority can directly obtain effective control of the concrete target object through a proven security-bearing mutation such as credential reset, membership modification, alias rebinding, or authentication-trust replacement. Control Methods, Control Parameters, and Impacts identify the takeover mechanism and outcome; ordinary administrative mutation remains Vault_ManageObject.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ReadConfig
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy can read configuration or backend-maintenance state on the target auth method, secrets engine mount, or concrete configuration child object; Operations and configuration targets identify the readable state.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ManageConfig
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy can create, update, delete, rotate, tidy, or otherwise operate on configuration and backend-maintenance surfaces on the target namespace, auth method, secrets engine mount, or concrete configuration child object; Operations and Requirements identify endpoint-specific actions and sudo requirements.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GenerateCredentials
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy has at least one proven viable mode for generating dynamic or lease-backed credentials from the target role-like object; Modes summarizes those viable outcomes. Credential generation with only unresolved external or configuration prerequisites uses Vault_PotentialAccess instead.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_ReadStaticCredentials
relationship_kinds.description: Access edge showing that a Vault policy can read current static credentials from the target static role-like object; engine_types, request_surfaces, credential_types, and operations identify the concrete backend behavior.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthApproleReadSecretId
relationship_kinds.description: AppRole visibility edge showing that a Vault policy can enumerate SecretID accessors or look up SecretID metadata for the target AppRole role.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthApproleGenerateSecretId
relationship_kinds.description: Traversable AppRole credential edge showing that a Vault policy can generate a standard or custom SecretID for the target observed AppRole role and can read or set the RoleID required for login; edge properties identify the RoleID source, SecretID constraints, token constraints, and applicable CIDR restrictions.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthApproleManageSecretId
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable AppRole maintenance edge showing that a Vault policy can destroy SecretIDs or SecretID accessors for the target AppRole role.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthAwsCreateRoleTag
relationship_kinds.description: AWS auth access edge showing that a Vault policy can generate a signed AWS auth role tag for the target role or a broad AWS-role surface.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthSamlDefaultRole
relationship_kinds.description: Configuration edge showing that a SAML auth method uses the target SAML role when login omits an explicit role name.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthSpiffeMayMatchRole
relationship_kinds.description: Configuration edge showing that an existing SPIFFE entity alias may select the target SPIFFE role because one or more workload ID patterns match.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenReadToken
relationship_kinds.description: Token auth access edge showing that a Vault policy can inspect token state through lookup, self-lookup, or accessor-lookup surfaces on the target token auth method mount; Requirements records the capability needed for each merged lookup surface.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenCreateRestrictedToken
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable Token auth issuance edge showing that a Vault policy can create a child, orphan, or role-backed token whose authority remains constrained by caller-policy inheritance or subset rules.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenCreatePrivilegedToken
relationship_kinds.description: Traversable Token auth issuance edge showing that a Vault policy can provably mint tokens with additional authority through sudo policy override on the target Policy Store, delegated policies on the target Token role, or identity policies reached through the target allowed Entity Alias.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenManageToken
relationship_kinds.description: Non-traversable Token auth maintenance edge showing that a Vault policy can renew or revoke tokens on the target Token auth method mount.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AuthTokenListAccessors
relationship_kinds.description: Token auth access edge showing that a Vault policy can list token accessors on the target token auth method mount when it also has the required sudo capability.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_AzureImportStaticRole
relationship_kinds.description: Azure access edge showing that a Vault policy can import existing Azure application credentials into the target static role, including metadata-only, full-import, or rotate-on-import workflows.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsEncrypt
relationship_kinds.description: GCP KMS access edge showing that a Vault policy can encrypt data with the target GCP KMS key.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsDecrypt
relationship_kinds.description: GCP KMS access edge showing that a Vault policy can decrypt data with the target GCP KMS key.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsReencrypt
relationship_kinds.description: GCP KMS access edge showing that a Vault policy can re-encrypt ciphertext to a newer key version with the target GCP KMS key.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsSign
relationship_kinds.description: GCP KMS access edge showing that a Vault policy can sign digests with the target GCP KMS key.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_GcpKmsVerify
relationship_kinds.description: GCP KMS access edge showing that a Vault policy can verify signatures with the target GCP KMS key.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_KvReadSecret
relationship_kinds.description: KV access edge showing that a Vault policy can read a KV secret value, and on KV v2 also expose version and custom metadata returned by the data surface.

relationship_kinds.name: Vault_KvManageSecret
